黑洞对行星近侧与远侧的拉力不同。差别太大时，行星逐渐被拉长；离开的物质形成细流，: Gravity pulls more strongly on the near side than the far side. A large enough difference stretches the planet into streams; some material returns and some moves outward.
慢放或拖动进度：观察原来蓝色或条纹的物质，怎样接成弯曲的长尾。: Slow down or scrub: follow the blue or striped material as it stretches into curved tails.
大小与时间已调整；绿色虚线是潮汐尺度，不是事件视界。: Sizes and time are adjusted. The dashed circle is a tidal scale, not the event horizon.
不一定。平均密度很重要：类地球行星较密实，类木星行星的平均密度较低。在相同黑洞与: Not necessarily. Mean density matters: an Earth-like planet is denser than a Jupiter-like planet. For the same black hole and path, a lower-density object can suffer strong tides farther out. A planet is not a fusion-powered star, but its disrupted material can still heat through shocks and accretion.
潮汐尺度采用 rₜ ≈ R(M黑洞/m行星)^(1/3)，同一黑洞下与平均密度的: The tidal scale follows rₜ ≈ R(M_BH/m_planet)^(1/3), hence mean density to the power −1/3 for a fixed black hole. The same particles are released layer by layer and then move under central gravity; extra inner damping only illustrates energy dissipation. The display absorption boundary cannot yield a physical accreted fraction. The NGC 4845 candidate reported by ESA was a massive planet or brown dwarf, not a confirmed terrestrial planet.
轨道中心用牛顿抛物线与 Barker 方程，最近距离依次为 2.50、1.25、: The center follows a Newtonian parabola using Barker’s equation, with pericenters of 2.50, 1.25 and 0.52 Earth-like tidal units. The Jupiter-like tidal scale is about 1.61. Release thresholds and inner damping are teaching assumptions, not predictions of true disruption thresholds or mass-loss rates.
类地球：海蓝色、岩石质。这里用平均密度比较，不把岩石强度当成完整模拟。: Earth-like: ocean blue and rocky. The comparison uses mean density, without a complete model of rock strength.
类木星：云带包裹的气态巨行星。虽然更大，平均密度却低于类地球行星。: Jupiter-like: a gas giant wrapped in cloud bands. It is larger, yet its mean density is lower than that of an Earth-like world.

平均密度决定潮汐尺度: Mean density sets a tidal scale
比较黑洞对天体近侧和远侧的差分引力与天体自引力，可得数量级上的潮汐半径。同一黑洞: Comparing differential gravity across a body with its self-gravity gives an order-of-magnitude tidal radius. Around the same black hole, a lower-density body can be strongly disrupted farther out. Internal structure and material strength also affect outcomes.
R、m、ρ̄ 分别为行星半径、质量和平均密度。比例系数随结构和判据而变；本模型将: R, m and ρ̄ are planetary radius, mass and mean density. The coefficient depends on structure and criterion; the Earth-like tidal scale is normalized to 1 here.
保持路线不变，切换两种行星，比较绿色潮汐参考圈的大小。: Keep the route fixed and switch planet types to compare their green tidal-reference circles.
“气态”不等于所有情况下都脆弱；这里隔离的是平均密度，未完整模拟岩石强度与流体内: “Gaseous” does not mean universally fragile; this comparison isolates mean density without fully modeling rock strength or fluid interiors.
近心距是轨道中心离黑洞最近的距离。穿透因子 β 将潮汐尺度与近心距比较：β 越大: Pericenter is the center trajectory’s closest approach. The penetration factor β compares tidal radius with pericenter: larger β generally means a deeper encounter, but one fixed value is not an exact universal disruption threshold.
v_p is pericenter speed on a Newtonian parabolic orbit. The routes use r_p = 2.50, 1.25 and 0.52 in Earth-like tidal-radius units; the same route can therefore yield different β values.
点最近处，在中间路线切换行星，比较 β 和材料是否保持完整。: Select closest approach and switch planets on the middle route. Compare β and whether the body stays intact.
屏幕上的行星被放大以便看清；不能拿画面半径直接计算真实近心距离。: Planet sizes are exaggerated for visibility; their screen radii cannot be used to calculate physical pericenter distance.
瓦解后的不同物质可具有不同轨道能量和角动量。一部分可以逃向远处，一部分保持束缚并: Different debris parcels can have different orbital energies and angular momenta. Some may escape, others remain bound and return, and some may enter an absorbing boundary. The same material is tracked rather than replacing it with a newly generated disk.
在牛顿点质量、无额外作用的近似下，ε < 0 表示束缚，ε > 0 表示非束缚。: In an isolated Newtonian point-mass potential, ε < 0 is bound and ε > 0 unbound. Illustrative inner damping is present, so energy is not conserved for every parcel throughout the display.
沿原来的蓝色或条纹物质向外看，区分长尾与仍在附近绕行的部分。: Follow the original blue or banded material and distinguish the tail from debris still orbiting nearby.
粒子代表物质量的示意，不是单块岩石或精确流体元；颜色也不是温度计。: Particles are illustrative material samples, not individual rocks or calibrated fluid elements; color is not a thermometer.

这是牛顿圆轨道的比机械能；降到更内侧轨道需要能量与角动量的适当交换，不能仅靠“引: This is the Newtonian circular-orbit specific energy. Moving to an inner orbit requires suitable energy and angular-momentum exchange, not merely stronger gravity.
比较外侧尾流和内侧绕行，再切换近景观察亮带的视角变化。: Compare the outer tail and inner circulation, then open the close-up and change view to inspect the bright band.
真实候选事件中的被扰动物体可能是大质量行星或棕矮星，并非已确认的地球式岩石行星。: In real candidate events, the disrupted object may be a massive planet or brown dwarf, not a confirmed Earth-like rocky planet.
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
先找完整的行星和黑洞，再按播放。绿色虚线帮助比较潮汐作用开始变强的位置；它不是黑: First locate the intact planet and black hole, then play. The green reference circle helps compare where tides become strong; it is not the black hole’s edge.
这条路线离得较远。行星转过弯，仍然保持完整；黑洞并不会把所有路过的东西都吞掉。: This route stays farther away. The planet turns and remains intact; a black hole does not swallow everything passing nearby.
这颗较密实的类地球行星仍保持完整。停在这里换成气态巨行星，看看同一条路线会有什么: The denser Earth-like planet remains intact. Pause and switch to the gas giant to compare the same route.
来到最近处，行星两侧受到的拉力差变大。看原来完整的形状，怎样开始拉长、散开。: Near closest approach, the difference in pull across the planet grows. Watch its original shape begin to stretch and disperse.
跟着原来的物质继续看：有些向远处拉成长尾，有些还在黑洞附近绕行。它们没有一下子全: Keep following the original material: some stretches into a distant tail and some keeps orbiting nearby. It has not all vanished at once.
后面仍有物质在运动。比较长尾和内侧绕行，再回到最近处，看看这些物质最初来自哪里。: Material is still moving later on. Compare the tail and inner circulation, then return to closest approach to see where it came from.
完整行星只是掠过，不会凭空产生吸积盘。若部分碎屑留下并绕回，碰撞与耗散可能使物质: An intact planet passing by does not create an accretion disk. If some debris remains bound and returns, collisions and dissipation may heat it until it radiates. Here, bright patches illustrate concentrations of returning debris; a complete disk is not guaranteed. Gravity bends the light, so an arc may appear above the black hole without the disk standing upright.
真实碎屑的碰撞、激波与角动量输运可影响圆盘化和吸积。本例以内区阻尼示意耗散，只从: Collisions, shocks and angular-momentum transport affect circularization and accretion. This example uses inner damping as a dissipation proxy and samples local brightness only from surviving, bound debris that has returned, then computes the bent optical image. It does not calculate physical temperatures or radiation spectra.
这是物理启发的教学模型，不是地球或木星的毁灭预报。行星、吸收边界和黑洞光学暗区使: This physics-inspired teaching model is not a prediction of Earth or Jupiter being destroyed. Planet size, absorption boundary and optical shadow use separate display scales. The dynamics do not solve rock fracture, fluid pressure or relativity. Local bright patches illustrate heating of returning debris, not a measured temperature or a guaranteed complete accretion disk.
